title: BVLC Write-Broadcast-Distribution-Table with one entry
purpose: Strengthen BVLC-function coverage by including a non-empty BDT payload instead of a zero-length shell.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP endpoint should recognize BACnet/IP BVLC framing and dispatch the Write-Broadcast-Distribution-Table function with one bounded table entry payload.
constraints_preserved: BVLC function 0x01 is used for a BVLC function-only frame.
No NPDU or APDU bytes are invented for this BVLC-only seed.
issue_safety_notes: This is a non-crashing structural coverage seed with a single small entry instead of any malformed BVLC replay.
